name: OSB/3
delivered_state: boards as sold, unfinished, standard thickness
constituents: wood strands (incl. moisture); binder (pMDI/MUF resin); additives (paraffin wax, release agent)
constituent_sources: median of EPD composition tables: EGGER EPD-EGG-20240403-IBD2 https://cdn.byggtjeneste.no/nobb/5d36f435-3690-467d-bea3-7316879f18da; Kronospan EPD-KRO-20230157-CBA1 https://medias.groupe-samse.fr/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire_892469.pdf; Sonae Arauco EPD-SON-20220209 https://www.sonaearauco.com/media/huhpryfz/epd_osb_oriented-strand-board_val2027.pdf
manufacturing_steps: debarking; flaking into strands; drying strands to 3-4 % moisture; screening; blending with resin and wax; forming the mat; continuous hot pressing; trimming and cutting; cooling; conditioning; sanding/cutting to size (if needed); packaging

name: Hempcrete (hemp-lime)
constituents: hemp shiv (incl. moisture); air lime (hydrated lime); natural hydraulic lime
constituent_sources: median of range midpoints of Schönthaler Hanfstein EPD BAU-EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-1 https://www.followthesun.dk/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-ECOINVENT-Hanfsteine.pdf and IsoHemp PAL36EX B-EPD 025-0078-002 https://orbi.uliege.be/bitstream/2268/339259/1/B-EPD%20-%20025-0078-002%20-%20IsoHemp%20PAL36EX%20-%20VF%20-%20signed.pdf
manufacturing_steps: batch mixing of hemp shives with binder and water; filling into a concrete-block forming machine and pressing; air drying (no energy); palletising on reusable pallets with PE strap

name: Cork board (expanded / agglomerated)
constituent_sources: Amorim Cork Insulation, Expanded Insulation Corkboard EPD HUB-0281 (EPD Hub) https://www.amorimcorkinsulation.com/xms/files/EPD_HUB-0281_2025_Amorim_Cork_Solutions_ICB_Expanded_Insulation_Corkboard.pdf
manufacturing_steps: grinding raw cork into granules; expansion and agglomeration of the granules in an autoclave with superheated steam (blocks); cooling with recycled water at ~90 °C; stabilisation in tunnel and ventilated space (no energy); cutting blocks to thickness; packing
